name: CreateOrder
description: Create a new sales order in the SAP ERP system. Trigger this function when the user explicitly asks to create, place, or add a new sales order. Requires at minimum a customer ID and at least one line item with a material code and quantity.

customer.description: The SAP customer ID or account number (e.g. '10100001'). Required.

doc_type.description: SAP document type code. Defaults to 'TA' (standard order) if not specified. Use null or omit if not mentioned.

sales_org.description: Sales organization code (e.g. '1010'). Use null or omit if not specified by the user.

dist_channel.description: Distribution channel code (e.g. '10'). Use null or omit if not specified.

division.description: Division code (e.g. '00'). Use null or omit if not specified.

currency.description: Currency code (e.g. 'USD', 'VND', 'EUR'). Use null or omit if not specified.

items.description: List of line items in the sales order. At least one item is required.

plant.description: Plant code (e.g. '1010'). Use null or omit if not specified.

unit.description: Unit of measure (e.g. 'PC', 'KG'). Use null or omit if not specified.
